Triggers when someone comments on a file: Triggers when someone comments on a file in a team, project or single file. Needs a Figma Professional plan or higher (Starter teams are refused); team webhooks need a team admin, project and file webhooks need edit access.
Triggers when a named version is saved i: Triggers when a named version is saved in a file's version history. Needs a Figma Professional plan or higher (Starter teams are refused); team webhooks need a team admin, project and file webhooks need edit access.
Triggers when a file is edited (Figma se: Triggers when a file is edited (Figma sends this after about 30 minutes without further edits). Needs a Figma Professional plan or higher (Starter teams are refused); team webhooks need a team admin, project and file webhooks need edit access.
Triggers when a library file is publishe: Triggers when a library file is published (components, styles or variables changed). Needs a Figma Professional plan or higher (Starter teams are refused); team webhooks need a team admin, project and file webhooks need edit access.
Triggers when a file is deleted. Needs a: Triggers when a file is deleted. Needs a Figma Professional plan or higher (Starter teams are refused); team webhooks need a team admin, project and file webhooks need edit access.
Whether to watch every file in a team, e: Whether to watch every file in a team, every file in a project, or one file. Team webhooks need a team admin; project and file webhooks need edit access.
For Team or Project, the number after /t: For Team or Project, the number after /team/ or /project/ in the Figma URL (e.g. figma.com/files/team/1234567890). For File, the file URL or file key.
Team ID: open the team in Figma; the URL: Team ID: open the team in Figma; the URL is figma.com/files/team/**1234567890**/... Project ID: open the project; the URL is figma.com/files/project/**12345678**/... File: paste the file URL.
